### God Wants You to Complain
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/god-wants-you-to-complain
Passage: Psalm 142:1-2
Points:
- Suffering and trials are normal, frequent experiences for believers in a fallen world.
- God gave the psalms of lament as worship guides for expressing heartache and sorrow.
- The Lord invites His people to bring their honest grief and complaints directly to Him.
- Biblical lament protects Christians from the false expectation of constant earthly prosperity.
- True lament is rooted in faith, anchoring itself in God's promises and Christ's ultimate victory.

### Never Alone
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-september-13-2016.html
Passage: Psalm 142:1-7
Points:
- Taking refuge in the cave of Adullam was David's lowest and most desolate moment.
- Despite profound isolation and fear, David continued crying out directly to God for deliverance.
- When the Lord brings believers to an apparent dead end, it is to reroute their lives rather than end them.
- God faithfully provides support and community even when people feel broken and tempted to isolate themselves.
